g.title: gate
g.text: Pin identity; register active manual job

g.title: attempt
g.text: At most two attempts for transient errors

g.title: post->archive
g.text: route absent: local Done + pending copy

g.title: note
g.text: Queue view = persistent active phases + active manual rows
Manual rows show Claimed; scheduled concurrency 1 is not a global limit
Manual completion preserves running or archived identities
Done is settlement, independent of completed / failed report outcome
